correction: reconcile_transcript_identity now requires spdi to match canonical GRCh38 syntax (NC_######.<version>:pos:ref:alt)

the parsed genomic accession must equal the in-scope gene's pinned genomic accession (config[gene]['genome_accession'], falling back to an explicit non-wildcard TSC1/TSC2 pin mirroring configs/ingest/tsc.yaml)
for SNV records, the parsed 0-based position/ref/alt must exactly match record.position-1/record.ref_allele/record.alt_allele
any missing/malformed spdi, wrong accession, or SNV coordinate mismatch now returns canonical_identity_unverified and routes to manual review, never a silent reconciliation
policy.py now reads canonical_spdi ONLY from record.provenance['canonical_spdi'] (_canonical_spdi helper) -- it no longer constructs a raw chr:pos:ref:alt key and passes it off as identity proof

direct BiasTsvSource records (no canonical-adapter/manifest enrichment) never populate provenance['canonical_spdi'], so they remain fail-closed to canonical_identity_unverified -- reconciliation only activates once a canonical adapter/manifest genuinely supplies verified identity (as tests/scorer/test_committed_pipeline_transcript_regression.py demonstrates via CanonicalManifestBiasSource)
TSC1 .5 scope addition, TSC2/NTHL1 out-of-scope routing, and same-base .4/.5 reconciliation-once-proven behavior are unchanged by this correction
checker_finding_correction.finding: reconcile_transcript_identity accepted a raw chr:pos:ref:alt echo of the record's own coordinates as canonical SPDI proof (policy.py's _raw_genomic_coords), so every TSC1/TSC2 .4-vs-.5 version delta was silently reconciled with NO independently verified genomic identity, and the identity check never validated SPDI syntax, gene genomic accession, or (for SNVs) position/ref/alt agreement.

known_policy_gaps_resolved: TSC1 added to scorer scope (config.genes) alongside TSC2

pure .4-vs-pinned-.5 version delta reconciled via base-accession identity (reconcile_transcript_identity), PROVIDED a canonical-adapter/manifest step has supplied VERIFIED canonical identity proof (record.provenance['canonical_spdi'], syntax + gene genomic accession + SNV pos/ref/alt all validated) -- no longer dumped to manual review once that proof exists

direct BiasTsvSource output (no canonical-adapter/manifest enrichment) carries no canonical_spdi and is correctly fail-closed to canonical_identity_unverified -- never silently reconciled off a raw chr:pos:ref:alt echo of its own coordinates
the 30 NTHL1 rows remain out_of_scope_gene manual-queue, excluded_from_scorer=True, never scored/re-attributed/classified

probe2_nthl1_locus_characterization.conclusion: TSC2-region (chr16p13.3, NC_000016.10) input mis-annotated to NTHL1 -- locus characterization only, no reclassification

probe3_spdi_version_invariance.conclusion: direct BiasTsvSource output carries no canonical_spdi provenance and is correctly fail-closed to canonical_identity_unverified; reconciliation only activates once a canonical-adapter/manifest enrichment step supplies a verified genomic SPDI (simulated above for illustration only -- never treated as trusted proof by this probe or by production policy)

verification.note: Test groups were run in SEPARATE pytest invocations to avoid a pre-existing, unrelated bare-"conftest"-module-name collision between tests/ingest and tests/kb (neither has __init__.py, so a rootdir-wide collection of both binds the top-level `from conftest import ...` in tests/ingest/test_ingest.py and tests/ingest/test_kit_conformance_ingest.py to whichever conftest.py sys.modules loaded first) -- unrelated to, and not introduced by, this correction.

covers: no regression introduced by the checker-finding correction
